name: Blue Owl Capital Inc.
moat_justification: Permanent capital (~$225B, ~70%+ of $319B AUM) makes fees durable; scale leadership in middle-market direct lending and net-lease; FRE margin 58.5% and expanding; $31.1B non-fee-paying AUM pipeline (~$380M future fees). Against: private-credit commoditization and spread compression, wealth-channel redemption/headline risk, untested loan-book credit through a downturn, founder concentration, SBC TTM $716M and share count +15.2%/yr. No ROIC series available (roic_proxy null, operating income untagged), so no evidence-based case for 7+.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 15.2%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier C (13.4%) vs bull-case tier A (21.6%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Permanent-capital fee machine, moat 6/10 — clears 15% at $8.85 on TTM numbers (17.6% weighted, IV@15 $10.94) but only just; bear case is Tier C and the $0.92 dividend outruns ~$0.87 distributable earnings/share; clean 15% hurdle price $10.94, 20% at $7.49.
moat_for: Permanent capital ~$225B (~70%+ of AUM) — durable fee base
Scale leader in US middle-market direct lending and net-lease
FRE margin 58.5% and expanding; LTM FRE +15%
$31.1B AUM not yet fee-paying ≈ ~$380M embedded future annual fees
Diversified: Credit / Real Assets / GP Strategic Capital
moat_against: Private credit commoditizing — BX/KKR/APO and banks compress fees/spreads
Wealth-channel redemption and headline risk (2026 BDC redemption story)
Loan-book credit quality (software exposure) untested through a downturn
SBC TTM $716M; share count growing 15.2%/yr dilutes per-share compounding
